epics.title: MainNav becomes a persistent left sidebar

stories.statement: MainNav renders as a persistent left sidebar with full labels, replacing the top bar, with app/layout.tsx restructured to host it

acceptance_criteria.given: MainNav currently renders as a top bar
acceptance_criteria.then: MainNav renders inside a left sidebar container instead of a top bar

acceptance_criteria.given: app/layout.tsx's root container currently uses flex-col
acceptance_criteria.when: the page renders after the retheme
acceptance_criteria.then: the root container's layout direction is flex-row

acceptance_criteria.when: the page is viewed at any point
acceptance_criteria.then: the sidebar remains visible with no collapse control and no drawer toggle present in the markup

acceptance_criteria.given: the sidebar renders its nav items
acceptance_criteria.then: each item shows its full text label rather than an icon-only representation

acceptance_criteria.given: MainNav's existing route paths and testids
acceptance_criteria.when: MainNav moves from the top bar into the sidebar
acceptance_criteria.then: those route paths and testids are unchanged

stories.statement: Sidebar is narrower on mobile than on desktop

acceptance_criteria.then: its width is narrower than the sidebar width rendered at a desktop viewport
it uses the full desktop sidebar width

epics.title: Active route gets a glowing highlight

stories.statement: MainNav becomes a Client Component so the active route's nav item renders with a glowing highlight

acceptance_criteria.then: it is declared as a Client Component (e.g. carries a "use client" directive)

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is viewing a particular route
acceptance_criteria.when: that route's corresponding nav item renders
acceptance_criteria.then: it displays a glowing highlight style while the other nav items do not

acceptance_criteria.given: a user clicks a nav item in the sidebar
acceptance_criteria.then: navigation proceeds to the same route it navigated to before the retheme, with no change in click behavior
